diagnostic_scope.checkpoint_selection_history: B was selected by earliest validation raw quantity RMSE before this diagnostic; the fixed B checkpoint is a measurement baseline and no validation row is materialized here
diagnostic_scope.cohort_reuse: reuse the exact 4096 target identities and series-disjoint folds frozen before model outputs by hard_lmm_qkv_path_diagnostic_v1
diagnostic_scope.fold_role: for each direction the normalized time head is fitted only on the source fold; the disjoint fold measures directional series-stability only because frozen B was previously trained on the entire train split, so this is not model generalization or held-out performance
diagnostic_scope.target_sampling: reuse exact hard_lmm_qkv_path_diagnostic_v1 sample_ids rows in their frozen order

frozen_reference.state_policy: encoder, static Hard-LMM bank and quantity head remain bitwise unchanged before and after the diagnostic

normalized_time_measurement.calculation_dtype: float64 from the affine maps through the observation likelihood

fit.epoch_semantics: one full source-fold batch and one optimizer step per epoch because 2048 targets are below cached_state_batch_size
fit.selection: the state after exactly epoch 100; no early stopping or best-epoch selection
fit.source: only detached B fused states and durations from the direction's source train fold
fit.source_fold_restart: initialize a new head from source-fold statistics independently for each direction

head.initialization: zero feature weights; location bias is the source-fold mean of log(duration/source-fold median); scale bias is inverse-softplus(source-fold population standard deviation minus 0.001); every duration is positive and the population standard deviation must exceed 0.001
head.statistics: time_scale is the exact source-fold median duration; mean and population standard deviation use log(duration/time_scale) from only the direction's source-fold targets

normalized_time_measurement.likelihood_numerics: continuous density includes the original-unit -log(time_scale) Jacobian; integer and censored probability uses float64 log_ndtr and stable log probability differences

observation_likelihoods.insta_market_basket: positive-integer round-and-clamp log-normal PMF; code 30 is right-censored survival S(29.5)
observation_likelihoods.intermittent_v2: continuous log-normal density in original duration units
observation_likelihoods.yellow_trip_hourly: positive-integer round-and-clamp log-normal PMF: p(D=1)=F(1.5), p(D=d)=F(d+0.5)-F(d-0.5) for d>=2

normalized_time_measurement.validity_gate: final source-fold proper Time NLL must be finite and strictly below epoch 0 by more than 1e-8; held-fold NLL and hidden gradient must be finite and the hidden-gradient norm must exceed 1e-12

probe.body_metric: raw quantity MAE for target quantity at or below the dataset train p95 frozen in the reused contract

boundaries.H2: full valid-sequence output after encoder.layers[1] and immediately before Hard-LMM retrieval
boundaries.fused: full valid-sequence H2 plus the current static Hard-LMM top-4 value residual

probe.fused_boundary_role: report-only overlap control because a post-LMM linear readout has already been evaluated

metrics.body: mean raw absolute quantity error over body targets
metrics.log: mean squared error in log1p quantity space and the source quantity-training objective
metrics.raw: mean raw quantity squared error; its descent direction is the raw RMSE descent direction
metrics.time: mean negative normalized K=1 observation log likelihood

probe.top4_locality_audit: at H1/H2, autograd holds the current hard top-4 membership locally fixed; calculate the fourth-minus-fifth cosine-similarity margin on every valid H2 token, require no exact tie, and do not infer finite-step behavior
probe.virtual_adapter: at each boundary, z'=mask*(z+z A^T) with A=0 and no bias; its 64x64 gradient is calculated from the entire valid sequence without changing the forward pass

prospective_gate.body_no_conflict: the separated quantity-arm dot with held-fold body-MAE gradient is at least negative epsilon, using the same scale-aware tolerance as the primary metrics

controls.aligned_equal_weight_shared: one adapter updated by the unit-normalized sum of source log-quantity and normalized K=1 time gradients; this is a counterfactual aligned objective and not B's historical legacy joint update
controls.aligned_norm_balanced_shared: one adapter updated by the unit-normalized sum of the individually unit-normalized source log-quantity and normalized K=1 time gradients
controls.permuted_separated: 63 cyclic shifts of the selected source arm over the adapter output rows; each preserves values and Frobenius norm and is a deterministic alignment-specificity control rather than an exchangeable statistical null

prospective_gate.directional_interpretation: for source update direction g and held-fold loss gradient h, dot(g,h)>0 means an infinitesimal update -g lowers the held-fold loss to first order
prospective_gate.gradient_validity: source log and time gradients, their equal-weight sum, their normalized sum, and every held metric gradient must be finite and have nonzero Frobenius norm; exact cancellation fails the boundary
prospective_gate.mathematical_gate: q=source log gradient, t=source normalized-time gradient, q_hat=q/||q||, t_hat=t/||t||, u_eq=(q+t)/||q+t||, u_bal=(q_hat+t_hat)/||q_hat+t_hat||, u_q=q_hat/sqrt(2), u_t=t_hat/sqrt(2). For held metric gradient h use u_q for log/raw/body and u_t for time. Let c=<u_arm,h>, s_eq=<u_eq,h>, s_bal=<u_bal,h>, and p_k=<roll_output_rows(u_arm,k),h> for k=1..63. Set epsilon=1e-12*max(1,|c|,|s_eq|,|s_bal|,|nearest_rank_higher_p95(p_k)|,||u_arm||*||h||). For log/raw/time require c>max(epsilon,s_eq+epsilon,s_bal+epsilon,nearest_rank_higher_p95(p_k)+epsilon).
prospective_gate.metric_gate: log, raw and time use mathematical_gate; body requires c >= -epsilon
prospective_gate.multiple_comparison_policy: every named check must pass; no aggregate average, dataset weighting or boundary selected after seeing results is allowed
prospective_gate.null_percentile: nearest-rank higher 95th percentile over all 63 non-identity cyclic shifts; it is a deterministic control threshold and is not a p-value or statistical significance test
prospective_gate.shared_vs_separated_norm: shared adapters have unit Frobenius update norm; the concatenated quantity and time updates of the separated two-adapter upper bound have total Frobenius norm one
prospective_gate.success_action: freeze one implementation contract for two task-specific zero-init 64x64 linear residual adapters at the first candidate-eligible boundary; H1 or H2 then routes quantity and time through separate downstream forward paths
prospective_gate.success_requirement: one identical candidate-eligible boundary and rule passes both fold directions on all three datasets
prospective_gate.upper_bound_semantics: the separated result is an adapter-specific first-order two-branch oracle for the counterfactual normalized K=1 objective; it does not diagnose existing block parameters, B's historical legacy joint update, trained validation improvement or finite-step top-4 changes

research_context: This diagnostic follows earlier QKV, readout, value-update and time-head analyses, so cyclic controls are engineering specificity checks within a sequential exploratory program and must not be presented as confirmatory statistical inference.
research_question: At one shared B Backbone boundary, does separating the quantity and normalized-time objective updates provide a stable train-only first-order advantage that also preserves the raw-RMSE and body-MAE directions across all three datasets?
